bull.point: Top-line revenue shows exceptional multi-year growth, compounding rapidly over a three-year span.
bull.evidence: Revenue compounded 29.2% a year over 3 years

bull.point: Quarterly operating margins expanded significantly in the latest period compared to the previous year.
bull.evidence: Latest-quarter margin 14% vs 10% a year ago

bull.point: Return on capital employed has substantially improved over the past five years to high levels.

bear.point: Profit growth trails top-line expansion, causing long-term operating margin contraction.
bear.evidence: Profit grew slower than revenue (15.7% vs 29.2% 3y CAGR): margins compressing

bear.point: The balance sheet carries significant leverage with debt exceeding equity.
Cash flow generation remains weak, with negative free cash flows in recent years.
bear.evidence: Free cash flow negative in 2 of last 6 years

watch_next: Verify if FY27 anchor margin stays on target at around 11%.
Track if CaratLane EBIT margin inches up from 8% towards 9%.
Monitor cash flow conversion to ensure CFO remains positive post FY26 rebound.
